name: Juguetron
description: Mexican toy and games retailer with an online store on VTEX. Its homepage heading states shipping to all of Mexico; it lists categories such as action figures, board games, baby toys and building sets.
description_es: Juguetería mexicana con tienda en línea sobre VTEX. El encabezado de su página principal indica envío a todo México; lista categorías como figuras de acción, juegos de mesa, juguetes para bebés y construcción.

ships_to.notes: Homepage heading says toys, games and gifts with shipping to all of Mexico; costs and times not stated on the homepage.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Homepage has a store locator; in-store pickup of online orders is not stated.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: shipping to all Mexico heading, categories, brands, store locator link
